```{=html}
<div class="page-container">
    <div class="section-header">
        <h1>Engage with Uncertainty. Shape the Future.</h1>
        <p>This summer school provides a unique opportunity to develop skills, strengthen networks, and advance creative and interdisciplinary research on uncertainty and the future.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="grid-container">
        <div class="info-card">
            <h3>Build Futures Capacity</h3>
            <p>Develop the knowledge, confidence, and collaborative mindset needed to navigate uncertainty and imagine alternative futures.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="info-card">
            <h3>Connect Ideas and Disciplines</h3>
            <p>Join a diverse international community to share knowledge, connect perspectives, and co-create new collaborations across disciplines and sectors.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="info-card">
            <h3>Advance Futures Research and Practice</h3>
            <p>Collaborate across disciplines to explore complex challenges and generate ideas that inform the creation of liveable futures.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="info-card">
            <h3>Imagine Liveable Futures</h3>
            <p>Explore new ways of thinking and creating to envision more sustainable and inclusive futures.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```
